Case: Shashank's optician combined two lenses with powers −3 D and +4 D so that he could see clearly.

60. Which of the two lenses can form a real image? 
A. only the lens with power -3 D 
B. only the lens with power 4 D 
C. both the lenses 
D. neither of the lenses
